channel.title: BEQCatalogue
channel.description: A RSS feed containing all BEQs created in the last 2 weeks

item.title: Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall
item.description: Arkham Asylum has been destroyed, and all its inmates have been unleashed upon Gotham City. As Batman races to round up some of his greatest enemies, he is pushed to his physical and mental limits and into a final confrontation with a new threat: the man called Bane!

item.title: Coherence
item.description: Four couples gather for dinner the night a mysterious and powerful comet passes overhead.

item.title: Lioness
item.description: Cruz Manuelos, a rough-around-the-edges but passionate young Marine, is recruited to join the CIA's Lioness Engagement Team to help bring down a terrorist organization from within. Joe, the station chief of the Lioness program, is tasked with training, managing and leading her female undercover operatives.

item.title: Interview with the Vampire
item.description: A vampire relates his epic life story of love, betrayal, loneliness, and dark hunger to an over-curious reporter.

item.title: Evil Dead Burn
item.description: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.

item.title: The Sheep Detectives
item.description: George Hardy is a shepherd who reads detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can't possibly understand. But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

item.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
item.description: Peter Quill, still reeling from the loss of Gamora, must rally his team around him to defend the universe along with protecting one of their own. A mission that, if not completed successfully, could quite possibly lead to the end of the Guardians as we know them.

item.title: The Grand Tour
item.description: Thomas, James and Francis receive an official blessing from Jeremy Clarkson, then head off on their first-ever adventure. During the road trip across southern California, they compare three of the greatest performance cars America has ever created: the Ford Mustang GTD, Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 and Hennessey Venom F5 Revolution Evolution. By racing against fighter jets, obviously.

item.title: The Grand Tour
item.description: Thomas, Francis and James journey from futuristic Singapore to the Malaysian highlands to investigate an important consumer question: for less than £5,000, is it possible to buy a sports car that's exciting to drive but also won't break down the whole time?

item.title: The Grand Tour
item.description: Following a pub chat with James May, the team head stateside to convince Americans of the brilliance of tiny Japanese Kei cars. And what better way for Thomas, James and Francis to win hearts and minds... than by sneaking off-road around Colorado before tackling the USA's most terrifying hillclimb: the 4,300-metre monster that is Pikes Peak?

item.title: The Grand Tour
item.description: The hosts are on a mission to find out the strongest car ever made. After a series of very destructive tests they enlist the help of Richard Hammond to help them crown the winner. Elsewhere, Thomas and Francis test out a classic Alfa Romeo and Subaru that have been 'restomodded' at enormous expense.

item.title: The Grand Tour
item.description: It's hypercar versus train as Thomas, James, and Francis race a Pagani Utopia against public transport from Britain to the Belgian Grand Prix, with an urgent delivery for Williams F1 driver Alex Albon. Elsewhere, James uncovers the incredible story of the BMW Isetta and its Cold War heroics.

item.title: The Grand Tour
item.description: Thomas, James and Francis head to Angola in a trio of deeply inappropriate track cars, in a bid to discover whether this corner of southern Africa is truly a hidden hotbed of back-to-basics motorsport. Will they discover racing in the wild desert? Or just a whole lot of sand and getting stuck?

item.title: 28 Days Later
item.description: Twenty-eight days after a killer virus was accidentally unleashed from a British research facility, a small group of London survivors are caught in a desperate struggle to protect themselves from the infected. Carried by animals and humans, the virus turns those it infects into homicidal maniacs -- and it's absolutely impossible to contain.

item.title: Jackass: The Movie
item.description: Johnny Knoxville and his band of maniacs perform a variety of stunts and gross-out gags on the big screen for the first time. They wander around Japan in panda outfits, wreak havoc on a once civilized golf course, they even do stunts involving LIVE alligators, and so on.

item.title: Jackass 3D
item.description: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. In addition to standing in the path of a charging bull, launching themselves into the air and crashing through various objects, the guys perform in segments such as "Sweatsuit Cocktail," "Beehive Tetherball" and "Lamborghini Tooth Pull."
